name: Vanta Bioscience Limited
summary: Vanta Bioscience Limited functions as an all-encompassing preclinical contract research organization (CRO). The firm extends a wide array of specialized offerings, including Discovery Toxicology, comprehensive assessments for Agro-Chemicals and overall Chemical Safety, Biocompatibility Studies, Diet Formulation, and Batch Release Testing. This company commenced operations on April 29, 2016, and its main office is situated in Hyderabad, India.
